value.definition: s_min = max(Q, floor), Q = upper order statistic at level 0.99 of S (primary answer-form readout) over all no-patch runs of the qualifying families of the respective cell (split A for the frozen value)
value.note: With m <= 100 no-patch runs, ceil(0.99 m) = m, so Q is the maximum of the m runs (m = 50 on split A).
value.resolution: a case is resolved iff S >= s_min and its answer-token mass >= 0.5

proposals.justification: Anchored to no-patch runs, whose answer lies outside the three candidate positions. Correct property (user correction of 2026-09-28): if a new no-patch run is exchangeable with the m runs and S has no ties, the probability that its S reaches the maximum of the m runs is 1/(m + 1), about 2% at m = 50; because s_min >= Q, the probability that a new unpatched run counts as resolved is at most 1/(m + 1). It is not '1% of unpatched runs'. The floor keeps q from being a ratio of tiny masses: a resolved case puts at least 10% of the entity mass on the three candidates.
